title: Bottlenecks
hook: Another salesperson won't help when production is already maxed out.
statement: Your system is only as strong as its tightest constraint.
explainer: Pushing stages with room does nothing. The slowest one caps everything.
sop: Find the minimum. That's your bottleneck.
Automate or delegate part of it.
equation_example: Intake 50, Production 20, Shipping 45. Output is the minimum, 20 a day. Not the average.
question: Name the bottleneck you've tolerated for months.
closing_statement: Everything moves at the bottleneck's pace.
